title: Reference-Space Reuse for Steady and Transient State-Constrained Conjugate Heat Transfer
summary: Repeated thermal optimization must enforce local temperature limits while solving linear systems whose unknowns change as the constraints activate and release. Zero-extension transfer, which carries correction vectors from one inactive set to the next, assigns zero to the degrees of freedom that a constraint has just released. We construct a spectral reference on the full state domain before optimization and restrict it directly to the current inactive set at each update, so the coarse correction receives reference entries at every released degree of freedom.
